title: Mistral says "Le Chonk" can challenge the best AI models
hook_before: Mistral just released an open weight model called Le Chonk.
script:
Mistral's new open weight model is named Le Chonk.
The French lab claims it can rival the best closed models.
It gives developers access to top tier performance without paying locked fees.
Would you run it on your own server?
